goals.objective: Restructure the Vantage UI SDK from a process-bound 3-tier stack (L1 tile / L2 drawer / L3 workbench) into a recursive, scale-agnostic viewing model: three primitives — OverviewTile (wall + desk densities), DetailDrawer (renders any entity's DetailExtract), ArchetypeCanvas (mounts any entity's deep-payload) — driven by a path-based Shell context stack with a named, runtime-enforced depth cap of 3, a registry keyed by subEntityId with optional SubEntityManifests, and a mock backend that derives all health/detail data upstream so the Shell only ever displays. SUCCESS CRITERIA (observable): (a) typecheck clean end-to-end; (b) Playwright walkthrough with zero console errors proving process-tile→process-drawer, workbench-node→sub-entity drawer showing DIFFERENT data (Ingest Batch queue depth etc.), Ingest Batch→its own mini-FLOW→member node→depth-3 detail, crumbs/back one scale up at every hop, and a blocked depth-4 attempt proving the cap; (c) grep gates = 0 raw palette colors and 0 archetype-name conditionals inside the Shell; (d) before/after computed-style diff shows visual change only where a view's ROLE changed; (e) blueprint + AGENTS.md rewritten in the same commit series to encode viewing modes ≠ data tiers, recursion, depth cap 3. BOUNDARIES — in scope: packages/ui-sdk src/ (types, mocks, Shell, components, tokens) + the two docs; out of scope: real backend/WebSocket transport, multi-app consumer isolation proof beyond a written note, seeded depth beyond 3, restyling role-unchanged views, new deep payloads for non-FLOW archetypes. CONSTRAINTS (hard): Principle 1 preserved — health/blast-radius computed only upstream (mock generator), never in components; token classes/CSS vars only, zero raw palette colors; one source of truth — no per-archetype branches in the Shell, sub-entity views declared via SubEntityManifest keyed by subEntityId; depth cap 3 is a named constant, runtime-enforced, and documented; visual parity where a view's role is unchanged; each milestone lands as its own green commit with typecheck + dev-server smoke first; workspace commands run from repo root. BLOCKER RULE: stop and ask the user if depth-3 seed data cannot keep wall-tier readability under drift, if any hard rule conflicts with what the code requires, or if an archetype's data shape cannot be expressed through the three primitives without a fourth primitive or per-archetype Shell branches.

decision.nextAction: Continue the goal at the user's request.
